english translation text: PLEASE TAKE ME BACK HOME TOO

arabic text: JAB RIHA SHAM KE ZINDAN SE HUE AHLE HARAM\nKYA KHUSHI HOTI DUBALA HUA SADAAT KA GHAM\nJISKO ARMANE RIHAAI THA HUI WO BEDAM
english translation text: WHEN THE CAPTIVES OF THE HOUSEHOLD OF THE AHLULBAYT WERE RELEASED FROM THE PRISON OF SHAM [SYRIA],\nLET ALONE ANY HAPPINESS, THE PAIN AND SORROW OF THOSE INNOCENT CAPTIVES DOUBLED,\nTHE ONE WHO HAD THE GREATEST DESIRE OF GETTING RELEASED BECAME SILENT FOREVER,

arabic text: EK NANHI SI LEHAD PAR THA MUSALSAL MATAM\nSUNKE FARYAD-O-FUGHAN SAANS RUKI JAATI THI\nQABR SE BALI SAKINA KI SADA AATI THI
english translation text: THERE WAS INCESSANT LAMENTATION AT ONE LITTLE GRAVE,\nTHE PAINFUL SOUND OF CRIES AND PLEADS MADE IT DIFFICULT TO BREATHE,\nA VOICE FROM LITTLE SAKINA’S GRAVE CRIED

arabic text: WATAN JAANE WALON MUJHE BHI WATAN LE CHALO\nMUJHE BHI WATAN LE CHALO
english translation text: OH PEOPLE GOING BACK,\nTAKE ME ALSO WITH YOU TO MY HOMELAND

arabic text: MAI KAISE RAHUNGI YAHAN PAR\nYAHAN HAI BHALA KAUN MERA\nMUJHE BHI WATAN LE CHALO....
english translation text: HOW WILL I STAY HERE? HOW WILL\nI STAY HERE? WHO DO I HAVE\nHERE? PLEASE TAKE ME BACK HOME TOO

arabic text:
REHA HOKE GHAR JAANE WALON, MUJHE BHI KAHIN PAR BITHA LO
SHAHEEDO KE SAR HAI JAHAN PAR, MUJHE BHI WAHIN PAR SULADO
MAI BABA KE SAR SE LIPAT KAR, SAFAR KAAT-LUNGI YE SAARA
MUJHE BHI WATAN LE CHALO....
english translation text:
OH RELEASED CAPTIVES GOING BACK HOME, MAKE ME ALSO SIT SOMEWHERE,
WHERE THE SEVERED HEADS OF THE MARTYRS ARE KEPT, MAKE ME SLEEP THERE AS WELL,
BY EMBRACING MY BABA’S HEAD,
I WILL PASS THE ENTIRE JOURNEY

arabic text:
NA YUN CHOR KAR JAO AMMA, MUJHE SHAMIYON KE SAHARE
YATEEMI KI MAARI HUI KO, SATAYA BAHOT ZAALIMO NE
BAHOT KHAUF AATA HAI MUJHKO, TUMHE WAASTA SAYYEDA KA
MUJHE BHI WATAN LE CHALO....
english translation text:
MOTHER DON’T LEAVE ME IN THE CARE OF
THESE PEOPLE OF SHAM [SYRIA] THE WICKED PEOPLE
TORTURED THIS ORPHAN A LOT, FEAR REALLY ENGULFS
ME, I BEG YOU IN THE NAME OF SYEDA

arabic text: SUNA HAI KE WAPAS MILAY HAI, TUMHEIN SHIMR SE MERE GOWHAR\nBHALA KYA KAROGE TUM UNKA, AGAR REHGAYI MAI YAHAN PAR\nINHI BHI AMAANAT SAMAJH KAR, YA DAFNA DO ZINDAN MAY YA
english translation text: I HEARD YOU GOT BACK MY EARRINGS FROM SHIMR,\nWHAT WILL YOU DO WITH THEM IF I STAY HERE,\nAS PART OF MY POSSESSION, BURY THEM HERE IN THE PRISON WITH ME

arabic text: JO PAHUNCHAY MADINA TO AMMA, PHIR RAQTE MUSIBAT NA AAYE\nSINA UR AKBAR KI BAATEIN, SUNANE KI NAUBAT NA AAYE\nMERI LAASH KO DEKH KAR HI, SAMAJH LEGI HAR BAAT SUGRA
english translation text: NO TROUBLE SHOULD COME TO MY MOTHER UPON REACHING MADINA, THE SITUATION\nOF NARRATING THE STORY OF THE ARROW AND AKBAR SHOULD NOT COME,\nJUST BY LOOKING AT MY DEAD BODY, SUGHRA WILL UNDERSTAND EVERY THING

arabic text: YEHI SOCH KAR ZAYRE TURBAT, TADAPTA HAI DUKHIYA KA LAASHA\nMUJHE SHIMR KE SHEHR MAY AB, HAMESHA HI REHNA PADEGA\nDHADAKTA NAHI PHIR BHI AMMA, YE DIL KAAMP JAATA HAI MERA
english translation text: THIS THOUGHT MAKES THE BODY OF THIS DEVASTATED CHILD TREMBLE IN HER GRAVE,\nI WILL HAVE TO STAY IN THE LAND OF SHIMR FOREVER, MOTHER\nMY HEART DOES NOT BEAT BUT STILL TREMBLES BY THE THOUGHT OF IT

arabic text: SARE SHAHE DEEN KUCH TO BOLO, SIFARISH KARO KUCH HAMARI\nKHAZA AAGAYI HAI TO PHIR KYA, MAI BETI HOO BABA TUMHARI\nNA INKAAR KAR PAYENGI WO, PHUPI SE ZARA KEHDO BABA
english translation text: O’ THE SEVERED HEAD OF THE NOBLE LEADER SAY SOMETHING, INTERCEDE ON MY BEHALF,\nEVEN THOUGH I HAVE DIED,I AM STILL YOUR DAUGHTER O’ FATHER,\nSHE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO REFUSE YOU, PLEASE JUST TELL AUNT

arabic text: YE HAALAT THI HAR EK QADAM PAR, MADINE KE RASTE MAY AKBAR\nGIRI THI JAHAN PAR SAKINA, TAMACHE LAGE THAY JAHAN PAR\nWAHAN KHAAK SE QAIDIYO KO, SADAYEIN YE AATI THI HAR JA
english translation text: SUCH WAS THE CONDITION O’ AKBAR, AT EVERY STEP OF THE JOURNEY TOWARDS MADINA\nWHEREVER SAKINA HAD FALLEN DOWN, WHEREVER SHE HAD BEEN SLAPPED,\nEVERYWHERE IN THOSE PLACES, THE CAPTIVES HEARD A VOICE SAYING..
